said:
I made one review pass over the build and found nothing to fix, so I changed nothing in it. I read the two build commits (71308ff and 5607d00) against the plan and the triage:

- **Files:** all six paths in the signed `touches:` list are handled, and the diff touches nothing outside them. The existing test files change only in the three card expectations the plan names: the new 108 height and the two button texts.
- **Acceptance criteria:** each one has a check in `test/card-buttons.test.js`. The button rectangles are pinned to exact numbers as well as bounded. The labels are checked to be drawn at the centres of the rectangles a click is tested against. The "refused upgrade changes nothing" and "Sell places no tower" checks would turn red if the click handler fell through to `clickCell`: the selection would clear, or a 20-gold lantern would be bought on cell (7, 2) and show gold 7 instead of 27. `cardButtonAt(undefined, …)` covers the no-tower guard.
- **Comments:** the ones in `src/hud.js`, `src/render.js` and `src/main.js` match what the code does, and the paths they name exist.
- **No fact twice:** the card and button sizes now live only in `src/hud.js`. `src/render.js` keeps only `radius`, `pad` and `line`, and `WIDTH`, `HEIGHT` and `TILE` are all still used there.

FOUND 0
GATES green (this repo has no Makefile and so no `check-build` target; the tree's only check is `npm test`, i.e. `node --test`, which I ran on the 11 test files from plan step 6: 111 passed, 0 failed, and the tree is clean and committed)
